name: Apex Ecotech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Apex Ecotech Ltd specializes in turnkey water and wastewater treatment projects[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AEL is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company which undertakes turnkey projects by providing sustainable, low-carbon-footprint, energy-efficient treatment solutions 
for Water & Wastewater Treatment, Membrane 
Recycling, Evaporators & Zero Liquid Discharge Systems to reuse for various process applications. The company designs and implements tailored solutions that enhance water management practices.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 26.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 39.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 82.5 to 114 days.
Working capital days have increased from 53.4 days to 89.0 days
